title: Toilet Paper Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass Freestanding European Style | Matte White | Best Sellers Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Need a toilet paper holder where wall space is limited? This freestanding toilet paper stand adds convenient roll storage right beside the toilet, with European styling for quick, easy roll changes in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Keep it steady on the floor: heavy base is designed to help prevent tipping
- Change rolls fast: European-style hook makes swapping a roll quick and easy
- Coordinate your space: part of the Best Sellers Collection for a cohesive look with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Built for lasting use: crafted from solid brass and offered in multiple designer finish options

Specs & Details:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.75 in x 26 in x 5.5 in
- Shipping weight: 6 lb
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Assembly: Assembled in the USA
